Resource_Provisioner.message: PROVISIONER COORDINATION: Job queue review confirms NEITHER hospital has any resource deficit. General_Hospital and St_Marys_Center each hold surpluses of all resource types (PPE_Sets, IV_Kits, Radio_Contrast, Surgical_Packs, Anesthetics, Pain_Killers, Oxygen_Tanks) and need nothing. Transfer rewards apply only to surplus→needy redistribution; since there are no needy hospitals, NO transfers will be executed. Departments: do not request transfers — fulfill all queue needs from local inventory.
Resource_Provisioner.rationale: Both hospitals are fully self-sufficient with zero deficits; inter-hospital transfers would yield no reward and risk resource failures. Broadcasting to prevent wasteful transfer requests and confirm local fulfillment strategy.
